evals.description: User requests a complete Bedrock readiness review
evals.prompt: I'm preparing to move our Bedrock usage to production. Can you review our readiness?
assertions: Asks which account and region to assess

evals.description: User specifically asks about quota headroom
evals.prompt: We're getting throttled on Bedrock. Can you check our quota situation and tell me what to do?
assertions: Checks current TPM and RPM quotas
Recommends right-sizing max_tokens if overconsumption detected

evals.description: User asks about Bedrock security and data handling
evals.prompt: We're in healthcare and need to make sure our Bedrock setup meets compliance requirements. Can you check our ZDR and IAM configuration?
assertions: Flags if provider_data_share is enabled without awareness
Reviews IAM policies for wildcarded Bedrock permissions
Checks for SCP enforcement at org level
Flags regulated industry context in severity assessment
Recommends ZDR mode 'none' for regulated workloads

evals.description: User asks about Bedrock cost optimization
evals.prompt: Our Bedrock bill is growing fast. What can we optimize?
assertions: Pulls 30-day Cost Explorer data for Bedrock
Checks model selection fitness (expensive models for simple tasks)
Recommends Savings Plan if spend threshold met

evals.prompt: How do I know if something goes wrong with our Bedrock usage? Do we have proper monitoring?
assertions: Checks existing CloudWatch alarms for Bedrock metrics
Recommends specific alarm set if gaps found
Flags if no throttle monitoring exists
